# Agent Definitions

This directory contains the agent definitions generated by `npx bddgen init-agents`.

To generate the agents:
```bash
cd examples/test-agents
npx bddgen init-agents --loop=vscode
```

The agents will help you:
- 🎭 **planner.md** - Explore the app and create test plans
- 🎭 **generator.md** - Convert test plans to Playwright tests
- 🎭 **healer.md** - Automatically fix failing tests
